articles.title: Watch: Denied chance to address CM, Cong MLA creates ruckus on stage
articles.summary: A Congress MLA, Harish Dhami, vandalised a stage at the Jauljibi Fair after being denied a speaking opportunity. This incident triggered a political uproar between the Congress and the BJP following the chief minister's attendance.

Travelling abroad? 35 days crucial if you want to make it to Census
articles.summary: Indian residents travelling temporarily abroad during Census 2027 will be counted at their usual residence. They must return within 35 days to qualify for inclusion in the count.

articles.title: Chicago photographer's $220 thrift store paintings sell for $135,000 after rare discovery
articles.summary: In an unexpected twist of fate, a photographer from Chicago stumbled upon two remarkable original pieces by Warner Sallman in a thrift store back in 2016. After investing $220 for them, his diligence paid off two years later when he sold the artworks to author Jerry Jenkins for an impressive $135,000, reshaping the market landscape for Sallman’s creations and showcasing the hidden treasures often overlooked in thrift shops..

articles.title: Hungarian investigators found $19.5 million in cash buried in forests and hidden in buildings while probing allegations against a former minister
articles.summary: Hungary's anti-corruption efforts have yielded significant results, uncovering over $19.5 million in cash, stashed away in forests and hidden properties. Former minister Miklós Seszták faces bribery charges tied to the transport sector, while Prime Minister Peter Magyar's initiative seeks to address corruption issues involving the previous administration of Viktor Orbán.

articles.title: Skeletons Cheer Cancer Patient: Ohio display encouraged Tammy during treatment; figures stay out year-round
articles.summary: In Oxford, Ohio, Bill Pyle's Halloween skeleton display became a beacon of hope for Tammy during her cancer journey. After receiving a touching letter, Pyle arranged the skeletons to honor her final radiation treatment, which shifted his perspective and deepened community bonds.

articles.title: ‘These tricks don’t work on me’: Eisenkot rejects Netanyahu’s 'unity govt' appeal
articles.summary: Caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu reiterated his call for a national unity government. Gadi Eisenkot, his political rival, dismissed Netanyahu's appeal, viewing it as a strategy to create division.

articles.title: West Bengal HS 3rd semester result 2026 expected to be released soon: Check where and how to download
articles.summary: The West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education (WBCHSE) is expected to announce the WB HS 3rd Semester Result 2026 by the second week of November. Students can check their results online using their roll and registration numbers.

articles.title: NIFTEE 2027 registration deadline extended to November 24;  check revised schedule and direct link to apply
articles.summary: The National Testing Agency has announced an extension for the NIFTEE 2027 registration deadline to November 24, 2026. The extended deadline applies to undergraduate, postgraduate, artisan, and PhD courses for the academic session.

articles.title: BSE Odisha announces Class 10 board exam dates 2027; exams to begin on March 12
articles.summary: BSE Odisha has released the schedule for the upcoming Class 10 board examinations in 2027. The exams will take place from March 12 until March 27, starting each day at 9 am.

articles.title: AIBE 22 admit card 2026 released at allindiabarexamination.com: Direct link to download hall ticket here
articles.summary: The Bar Council of India has issued the admit card for the AIBE 22 examination scheduled for November 29, 2026. Candidates can download their hall tickets by visiting the official website and entering their login credentials.

articles.title: Tamil Film Producers Council plans felicitation for CM Vijay
articles.summary: The Tamil Film Producers Council is hosting a special gathering to pay tribute to Chief Minister Vijay for his unwavering support. They have expressed heartfelt appreciation for the newfound approval of six daily screenings in theatres throughout Tamil Nadu.

articles.title: 'Scene' editor Ajmal Sabu reveals how plot leak changed Suriya's film
articles.summary: A major plot leak regarding the film 'Scene' forced the editing team to make changes before release. Editor Ajmal Sabu explained how the leak affected the viewing experience of audiences.

articles.title: When Rajkumar Periasamy broke down after hearing Vijay's final film
articles.summary: In a touching moment, Sai Pallavi disclosed how director Rajkumar Periasamy broke down in tears while viewing the promotional video for Vijay's final film, 'Jana Nayagan.' This poignant reaction underscores Rajkumar's deep appreciation for Vijay's craft. He also extended his congratulations to Vijay for becoming the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu.

articles.title: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash's film earns over 3 times 'Animal'; crosses Rs 1,200 cr worldwide
articles.summary: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash's 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' has achieved remarkable box office success in its second week. After recording Rs 72.90 cr net on Day 10, the film's total domestic collection reached Rs 685.60 cr.
